alignment_handling.enumeration_truncated: Do not use an incomplete alignment enumeration to establish uniqueness or resolve selection.
alignment_handling.model: Lowest numeric coordinate model, as previously used.

approval_scope: Define the previously unspecified secondary metrics without changing the original selection hierarchy.

missing_required_backbone_atom_count.calculation: Sum missing or invalid N, CA, C and O atoms over that population.
missing_required_backbone_atom_count.population: All standard BMRB entity residues uniquely and identity-consistently mapped across every optimal alignment, including mapped residues with incomplete backbone atoms.

usable_coordinate_residue_coverage.comparison: Compare integer numerator/denominator ratios exactly; do not resolve ties using rounded floating-point values.
usable_coordinate_residue_coverage.denominator: Full frozen BMRB entity sequence length, including unknown and nonstandard positions.
usable_coordinate_residue_coverage.numerator: Count standard BMRB entity residues whose coordinate mapping is identical across every optimal alignment, whose residue identity matches, and whose coordinate residue has valid N, CA, C and O atoms.
usable_coordinate_residue_coverage.valid_atom: Atom exists, occupancy is greater than zero, and all Cartesian coordinates are finite.
